name: agile-mods
description: Claude Mods for the agile-skills loop: /agile-board opens the agile console pane (board with burndown, ticket and PR flow, drain passes with cost, guards and receipts, links), read live from gh and the Jira MCP rather than from the model's answers, with a status-line entry and an alert row above the prompt; guards that check GitHub at merge time (pinned live head, green CI on it, every file read by a reviewer), enforce agent tool grants, and refuse pushes to main and force pushes inside the loop; /receipts checks agent receipts against the contract; retro counts for agile-15. Needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later.

autoOpen.title: Open the console when a drain starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the agile console pane, unfocused, when agile-sprint-drain starts. It appears only in a terminal at least 144 columns wide; /agile-board opens it at any width.
